card.name: Words just before a verb or clause
card.fires_on: Small connecting words such as "to", "and", "instead" or "us" that sit right before a verb phrase, mostly in formal explanatory prose. It also fires on a few other mid-sentence words.

modes.label: "to" before a verb
modes.description: The word "to" after a noun like capacity or a form of "be", leading into an action verb.
modes.example: The ill effects of isosorbide mononitrate overdose are generally the results of isosorbide mononitrate's capacity<< to>> induce vasodilatation, ven

modes.label: Linking word in a list of actions
modes.description: "and" or "instead" joining one action to the next in a sentence.
modes.example: jawboned the steel companies to back down from inflationary price increases,<< and>> became the first President to recognize the right

modes.label: Other mid-sentence words
modes.description: Scattered words inside a noun phrase or a verb phrase, where a continuation is expected.
modes.example: the Bön religion has actually<< gone>> through three distinct phases: Animistic B

card.writes: It seems to suppress opening quote and bracket marks, so the next word is more likely plain text than a quote.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words that lead into the next action in a sentence.
